scientific_integrity: The proof uses the exact prime factorization of \(n^aJ_s(n)^b\), separates common and symmetric-difference prime support, derives two divisibilities, and multiplies their strict size bounds. Finite computation is used only as regression evidence.
scientific_limitations: The result gives a necessary collision inequality and proves injectivity on powerful integers, but does not settle the full case \(s\ge3\), \(a<sb\) on all positive integers.
title: A support-exponent obstruction for Jordan-totient product collisions
